name: restApiTokenExpiryEnforced
definition: True when the API credential has a bounded lifetime, so keys or tokens expire and must be reissued.
population: the API key or token lifetime setting of the firewall or management service the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A successful read of the authentication settings showing a lifetime greater than zero (or an enforced maximum); zero or never-expire is False; an error, empty or absent setting is Not evaluated.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)
Public OpenAPI reference for Cloud NGFW for AWS (pan.dev/cloudngfw/aws/api/)

changeLog.change: Registered so the Palo Alto firewall transformations (hardware and cloud) can emit it. Meaning is vendor-neutral and written from public references only; no real device or customer read, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: The setting read is the service-wide lifetime, not each individual key.
